BROKEN: value
TOKEN=#live # note
EMPTY= # note
TAIL
"`. Return a JSON array in emission order, with exactly `key`, `value`, `line`, and `error` in each object; `line` is the binding's original starting line. Include error bindings rather than filtering them out.
